acceptance_predicates.description: Every ASB-supported executable tool has one reviewed catalog entry or is explicitly unsupported/development-only; workload bundles use the separate asb workload catalog.

The initial executable catalog covers Aider, Codex, Gemini, Goose, Mini-SWE, OpenCode, OpenDesk, OpenHands, OpenJiuwen, Qwen Code, development-only cli2key when enabled, and optional perf/bpftool monitoring, while classifying provider APIs and host capabilities correctly.
Every installable entry names its official primary source, exact immutable binary/source identity, platform compatibility, verifier, license, and entrypoint.
Entries define a verified compatible-system reuse path, official prebuilt path where available, and bounded pinned-source fallback where buildable.
The catalog supports asb tool install by supported ID without a user-supplied source and rejects arbitrary URLs, package-manager installs, shell snippets, and unverifiable artifacts.
Unsupported platform, missing proof, unavailable primary source, incompatible license, and absent build recipe retain distinct actionable diagnostics.

definition_of_done: Catalog schema, entries, fixtures, and contributor documentation pass provenance/schema tests.
Independent review and exact-head hosted checks pass.

inputs.description: AR-1761 project-local registry and AR-1762 discovery baseline.

outputs.description: Versioned official source, verifier, platform, artifact, and build-recipe catalog.

gates.description: Schema and catalog inventory validate every supported entry and immutable primary source.
Unverified, unsupported, revoked, incompatible, and arbitrary acquisition paths fail closed with distinct diagnostics.
